adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a process-wide switch for refresh routing: `refreshOAuthTokens` routes *all* OAuth refreshes to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is truthy and `userId` is present (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). Multiple integrations now call this helper (Google, HubSpot, Lark, Office365, Zoom, Webex, Zoho, etc.), so enabling these envs affects them all with no per-integration/per-credential opt-in and no fallback if the sync endpoint is down/non-OK. That’s an architectural/operational risk created by the change and is grounded in the diff, though it’s not an automatically-verifiable “bug” absent requirements about fallback behavior.
